fields.name: eventId
fields.description: Provider response id (msg_..., resp_..., responseId), pm_<sha256> when none, or manual_<id>. Unique.

fields.name: source
fields.description: proxy | manual

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Owner. Set by the workflow from the ingest key or the caller's login, never by the client.

fields.name: teamId
fields.description: Team (Blocks organization id). Set by the workflow, never by the client.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: claude-code | codex | antigravity-cli | api | other

fields.name: provider
fields.description: anthropic | openai | google

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model named in the provider response.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Tool session marker or heuristic session id; may be null.

fields.name: promptId
fields.description: Groups the calls caused by one typed prompt.

fields.name: callIndex
fields.description: Order of this call within its prompt.

fields.name: totalInputTokens
fields.description: All input tokens, cached included (normalized per adapter).

fields.name: uncachedInputTokens
fields.description: Input tokens billed at the base input rate.

fields.name: cacheReadTokens
fields.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

fields.name: cacheWrite5mTokens
fields.description: Input tokens written to the 5-minute cache.

fields.name: cacheWrite1hTokens
fields.description: Input tokens written to the 1-hour cache.

fields.name: outputTokens
fields.description: Output tokens, thinking included.

fields.name: thinkingTokens
fields.description: Thinking tokens when the provider reports them, else null. Not added to cost.

fields.name: serverToolRequests
fields.description: Server tool requests (web search, web fetch).

fields.name: speed
fields.description: standard | fast | null

fields.name: costUsd
fields.description: Cost computed when the event arrived; null when unpriced.

fields.name: pricingStatus
fields.description: priced | unpriced

fields.name: promptPreview
fields.description: Cleaned preview, at most 100 characters. Owner-only column.

fields.name: projectTag
fields.description: Optional project label from the collector.

fields.name: accountEmail
fields.description: Tool account email the proxy detected on the user's machine, lowercased; null when none.

fields.name: accountVerified
fields.description: True when the key owner linked that tool account (LinkedAccount) at ingest time.

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.description: UTC time the collector finished reading the response.

fields.name: receivedAt
fields.description: UTC time the workflow stored the event.
